deviation: The draft auto-renews for successive 12-month terms unless either party gives 90 days' notice, where Arcadia's standard has no auto-renewal. This matches the playbook fallback (90-day notice window), so it is acceptable. The draft doesn't cap renewal price increases at the playbook's 5%, so a price rise could take effect on renewal.
suggested_text:
2.1 This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and, unless terminated earlier in accordance with its terms, continues until March 2, 2028 (the "Term"). 2.2 This Agreement does not renew automatically. Any extension of the Term requires a written agreement signed by both Parties.

[Fallback, if Supplier insists on auto-renewal: 2.2 Following the Initial Term, this Agreement renews for successive 12-month periods unless either Party gives the other at least ninety (90) days' written notice of non-renewal before the end of the then-current term. Fees for any Renewal Term shall not increase by more than five percent (5%) over the fees in effect during the immediately preceding term.]
